description: The T8700 eufyCam security solar panel is an off-grid solar panel designed for powering security cameras.
hts_note: Classified as photovoltaic cells assembled in modules or made up into panels under heading 8541.

description: Edge-glued boards made of wood, continuously shaped wood, finger-jointed, and edge-glued mouldings or millwork blanks, whether or not resawn.
hts_note: Edge-glued wood boards and blanks not further worked into joinery or covered by heading 4407/4409 are classified as other articles of wood under subheading 4421.99.9840.

description: Canvas banner matisse consisting of a primed or coated polyester fabric in rolls, used for art reproduction, wall covering, and décor applications.
hts_note: Classified as prepared painting canvas under heading 5901, which covers primed textile fabrics used for artistic reproduction.

description: Low-carbon steel blanks used as unfinished parts for tapered roller bearings.
hts_note: Classified under heading 8482 as unfinished parts (blanks) for tapered roller bearings pursuant to General Rules of Interpretation 1 and 2(a).

description: Front foot and front foot caster assembly designed for exercise equipment, cut from steel sheet into a non-flat, non-rectangular shape and combined with other components.
hts_note: Classified as parts and accessories of physical exercise equipment under heading 9506.

description: Finished aluminum coil intended for use in roofing products.
hts_note: Classified as aluminum alloy plates, sheets, or strip, rectangular or coiled, of a thickness exceeding 0.2 mm but less than 6.3 mm, commonly used for roofing applications.

description: Calcium glycinate, a chemical compound and precursor of glycine.
hts_note: Calcium glycinate is a salt of glycine, classified under oxygen-function amino-compounds as salts of glycine.

description: An end module side cover and cable tray connection brackets designed as components of modular battery storage assemblies.
hts_note: Classified as parts of electric accumulators and modular battery storage systems under heading 8507.

description: Calcium glycinate, a chemical compound that serves as a precursor to glycine.
hts_note: Calcium glycinate is classified as a salt of glycine under amino-acid compounds in heading 2922.

description: Calcium glycinate, a chemical compound that serves as a precursor to glycine.
hts_note: Calcium glycinate is classified as a salt of glycine under amino-acid compounds in heading 2922.

description: Wagner Spray Tech Corporation part number 805-324 manifold, made of extruded aluminum.
hts_note: Manifolds for paint spraying appliances are classified as parts of mechanical liquid spraying appliances under heading 8424.

description: Certain wooden case pieces of furniture designed and advertised for bedroom use, including pieces suitable for storing clothing.
hts_note: Classified as wooden furniture of a kind used in the bedroom, specifically case goods such as chests of drawers, dressers, and wardrobes.

description: Twist ties paired with decorative bows, consisting of a twist tie closure component and a bow component that are either unattached or joined by a single stitch.
hts_note: Decorative textile ribbon bows attached to or paired with twist ties are classified as other made-up textile articles.

description: Type SER and Type URD aluminum conductor cables incorporating uninsulated aluminum wire cable.
hts_note: Type SER and URD aluminum cables are insulated electric conductors rated under 1,000 V without connectors.

description: Small diameter continuously shaped wood dowels made of wood.
hts_note: Continuously shaped rounded wood dowels or dowel rods are classified under heading 4409 as other continuously shaped nonconiferous wood.

description: Collared studs with heads that are not straight, identified by part numbers 2003.1027CTI, 2012.0306, 1405307CTI, and 1448160CTI, with three of the four parts lacking a circular diameter.
hts_note: Because the collared studs feature non-straight heads and non-circular profiles, they fail to meet the standard definitions for fasteners of heading 7318 and are classified as other articles of iron or steel.

description: Five types of collared studs, identified by part numbers AF020710, B34-6005, 5445362/CTI, 2003.2021, and HW100149, which are headed, non-straight fasteners lacking a circular diameter.
hts_note: Classified as other threaded screws and bolts of iron or steel having a shank or thread diameter of 6 mm or more, because the fasteners feature heads or collars and irregular diameters that preclude classification as simple studs.

description: Calcium glycinate, a chemical compound that is a precursor of glycine.
hts_note: Calcium glycinate is classified as a salt of glycine under oxygen-function amino-compounds.

description: Six types of circular welded non-alloy steel pipe originally from the United States that undergo further processing in Mexico prior to importation.
hts_note: Circular welded non-alloy steel pipes are classified under subheading 7306.30 as welded pipes of circular cross section of iron or non-alloy steel.

description: Fifteen models of torque tubes consisting of mechanical steel tubes.
hts_note: Torque tubes function as transmission shafts designed to transmit rotary motion, falling under other transmission shafts.

description: Finished chassis containing subassemblies, whether assembled or unassembled, used for intermodal transport.
hts_note: Container chassis used for intermodal transport are classified as other trailers and semi-trailers for the transport of goods.

description: Seven models of bedroom beds that are not made substantially of wood.
hts_note: Classified as metal household beds, as non-wooden bedroom beds are typically constructed of metal.

description: Cabinets and vanities made from phragmites particle board.
hts_note: Cabinets and vanities made of particle board, a ligneous wood-like material, are classified as other wooden furniture.

description: Fritech, a waste mineral-based synthetic stone surface product composed predominantly of silica along with a resin binder, in the form of slabs or other surfaces.
hts_note: Articles of artificial/agglomerated stone composed of mineral silica and resin binder formed into slabs fall under heading 6810.

description: Monopiles consisting of steel cylinders designed to serve as foundations for offshore wind turbines.
hts_note: Steel monopiles designed as structural foundations for offshore wind turbines are classified as other structures or parts of structures of iron or steel under heading 7308.

description: Certain electrical conduit fittings, including electrical conduit bodies, nipples, and couplings and connectors. These fittings are manufactured to electrical industry codes and standards and are not suitable for oil, gas, or sprinkler applications.
hts_note: Cast malleable iron pipe or conduit fittings, such as conduit bodies, couplings, and connectors, are classified under heading 7307 as tube or pipe fittings of iron or steel.

description: Steel truck wheels comprised of rim and disc component parts, designed for use on trucks.
hts_note: Steel road wheels designed for use on motor vehicles such as trucks fall under heading 8708 as parts and accessories of motor vehicles.

description: Individually quick frozen (IQF) cooked garlic cloves intended for use as a food or seasoning ingredient.
hts_note: Classified as other vegetables prepared or preserved otherwise than by vinegar or acetic acid, frozen, since cooking beyond simple steaming or boiling in water excludes it from Chapter 7.

description: Whole garlic cloves in brine, preserved with the addition of other ingredients, mechanically harvested and not intended for use as fresh produce.
hts_note: Whole garlic cloves preserved in brine and not provisionally preserved are classified as other vegetables prepared or preserved otherwise than by vinegar or acetic acid.

description: Aluminum coil produced from 8011 alloy aluminum, having a thickness greater than 0.2 millimeters and equal to or less than 6.3 millimeters.
hts_note: Aluminum coil made of 8011 alloy with a thickness between 0.2 mm and 6.3 mm is classified under rectangular, not clad aluminum alloy plates, sheets, and strip.

description: Retail display shelves designed for displaying headphones and speakers in a retail setting.
hts_note: Retail display shelves are classified as other metal furniture commonly used in commercial and retail environments.

description: Monopiles consisting of steel cylinders designed to serve as foundations for offshore wind turbines.
hts_note: Steel monopiles designed as structural foundations for offshore wind turbines are classified as other structures or parts of structures of iron or steel under heading 7308.

description: Certain light-truck spare tire models identified under part code TG00000100.
hts_note: Classified as new pneumatic rubber tires of a kind used on buses or trucks, specifically radial light-truck tires.

description: Heat-treatable clad alloy aluminum sheets with either Aluminum Association alloy designation 2024 or 7075.
hts_note: Classified as clad rectangular aluminum alloy plates, sheets, or strip with a thickness exceeding 0.2 mm under heading 7606.

description: Whole garlic cloves provisionally preserved in brine that have not been heat processed.
hts_note: Garlic cloves provisionally preserved in brine and unsuitable in that state for immediate consumption are classified as other provisionally preserved vegetables under heading 0711.

description: Aluminum foil designed for use in capacitors.
hts_note: Aluminum foil designed for capacitor manufacturing is typically etched and specifically classified under etched capacitor foil.

description: Aluminum composite panels consisting of a thermoplastic core bonded between two aluminum alloy sheets.
hts_note: Aluminum composite panels derive their essential character from the aluminum outer layers and are classified as other articles of aluminum.

description: #2 pencils, drawing pencils, and colored pencils designed for writing, drawing, or coloring.
hts_note: Pencils with leads encased in a rigid sheath for writing or drawing are classified under heading 9609.

description: Wooden dowels intended for later processing into lollipop sticks.
hts_note: Wooden dowels that are continuously shaped and rounded along their length fall under heading 4409 as nonconiferous continuously shaped wood.

description: Steel freight rail coupler parts, specifically E type yokes and F type yokes, manufactured in accordance with Association of American Railroads (AAR) specification M-211.
hts_note: Classified as parts of coupling devices for railway freight cars under heading 8606.

description: Off-grid solar charging modules containing crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells, identified by part numbers GC4291F, GC4291FE, GC3291F, or GC3291FE.
hts_note: Photovoltaic cells assembled into modules or made up into panels containing crystalline silicon.

description: Passenger vehicle and light truck steel discs and rims with specific hub bore sizes, offsets, load ratings, or bolt patterns that render them unsuitable for use on trailers or towable equipment.
hts_note: Classified as parts of motor vehicle road wheels, specifically wheel rims, under heading 8708.

description: Certain light-truck spare tire models made of rubber, identified under part code TP10657100, intended for use on light trucks.
hts_note: New pneumatic radial rubber tires of a kind used on light trucks are classified under this tariff number.

description: Fourteen roof tiles imported together as a pagoda roof kit, as well as decorative board brick.
hts_note: Ceramic roofing tiles, including those imported in kits for pagoda roofs, are classified as roofing tiles under heading 6905.

description: Merchandising displays and components thereof, featuring steel roll-formed horizontal load-bearing members with an overall depth that does not exceed two inches.
hts_note: Classified as other metal furniture comprising display fixtures, racks, or shelving units.
